title.en: StepFun opens Step 5 Preview weights under its model license
title.zhHans: 阶跃星辰依据其模型许可证开放 Step 5 Preview 权重

searchSummary.en: StepFun made Step 5 Preview weights available through Hugging Face under the StepFun Model License 1.0; contemporaneous reporting dated the weight opening to October 15.
searchSummary.zhHans: 阶跃星辰通过 Hugging Face 依据 StepFun Model License 1.0 提供 Step 5 Preview 权重；同期报道将权重开放日期记为 10 月 15 日。

summary.en: StepFun made Step 5 Preview weights available through Hugging Face under the StepFun Model License 1.0; contemporaneous reporting dated the weight opening to October 15.
summary.zhHans: 阶跃星辰通过 Hugging Face 依据 StepFun Model License 1.0 提供 Step 5 Preview 权重；同期报道将权重开放日期记为 10 月 15 日。

narrative.en: The model card supports self-hosted serving and offline generation, but the license includes model-specific attribution and commercial-use conditions. Model performance claims remain vendor-reported and adoption is not yet established.
narrative.zhHans: 模型卡支持自托管服务和离线生成，但许可证含有模型特定的署名和商业使用条件。模型性能主张仍来自厂商披露，采用情况尚未得到证明。

text.en: StepFun made Step 5 Preview weights available on Hugging Face under the StepFun Model License 1.0.
text.zhHans: 阶跃星辰在 Hugging Face 上依据 StepFun Model License 1.0 提供 Step 5 Preview 权重。

text.en: The model license includes attribution and commercial-use conditions, and vendor performance claims have not been independently replicated.
text.zhHans: 该模型许可证含有署名和商业使用条件，厂商性能主张尚未得到独立复现。
